data.title: Why Understanding Software Cycle Time Is Messy, Not Magic
data.author: SiempreViernes
data.article_summary: 文章《No Silver Bullets: Why Understanding Software Cycle Time is Messy, Not Magic》通过分析超过55,000个观察数据，研究影响软件开发周期时间的因素。作者使用贝叶斯层次模型，区分个体和组织差异，探讨编码时间、任务范围和协作模式对周期时间的影响。研究发现，尽管工作场所因素对周期时间有预期中的影响，但这些影响相对 modest（ modest：适度的），且存在显著的个体和组织间差异。文章强调，单个观察数据对典型性能的反映有限，提升软件交付速度需要系统层面的思考，而非仅关注个体干预。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：周期时间（cycle time）作为评估开发人员生产力的指标的价值和局限性。

不同观点：
• [tmnvdb] 认为周期时间不应被用来评估个体开发人员的生产力，而应作为捕捉整体流程低效、变异性和瓶颈的指标。这种系统性的视角在看板方法论中尤为重要，常用于预测交付时间线。

• [wry_durian] 承认周期时间的重要性，但提出三个问题：首先，周期时间只是总成本方程中的一个代理变量；其次，它是一个滞后指标，对系统控制杠杆的预见性有限；最后，队列大小对下游经济问题的影响更大，因此应优先考虑队列大小。

• [SiempreViernes] 引用了一项大规模研究，指出周期时间与多种因素（如编码天数、合并请求数量、协作程度）之间存在精确但 modest 的关联，但个体之间的变异性很大。

• [resource_waste] 分享了个人经验，指出即使细致地分解任务时间，实际完成时间往往远超预期，甚至达到3倍以上，质疑直觉估算的可靠性。

• [dgfitz] 指出在当前的组织中，周期时间可能长达一年，特别是在嵌入式开发中，Jira等工作流工具并不 optimal，因此质疑该研究对非web开发环境的适用性。

补充讨论：
• 周期时间在不同开发环境（如web开发与嵌入式开发）中的适用性和局限性。
• 周期时间作为滞后指标的局限性，以及与队列大小等其他指标的关系。
• 个人经验中对周期时间和任务时间估算的直觉偏差，及其对生产力评估的影响。
• 对周期时间的系统性视角和其在预测交付时间线中的作用的不同看法。

争议焦点：
• 周期时间是否应作为评估个体开发人员生产力的指标。
• 周期时间与其他指标（如队列大小）在分析开发流程效率中的优先级和作用。
• 周期时间在不同开发环境中的适用性和有效性。

Authors:

View a PDF of the paper titled No Silver Bullets: Why Understanding Software Cycle Time is Messy, Not Magic, by John C. Flournoy and 3 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Understanding factors that influence software development velocity is crucial for engineering teams and organizations, yet empirical evidence at scale remains limited. A more robust understanding of the dynamics of cycle time may help practitioners avoid pitfalls in relying on velocity measures while evaluating software work. We analyze cycle time, a widely-used metric measuring time from ticket creation to completion, using a dataset of over 55,000 observations across 216 organizations. Through Bayesian hierarchical modeling that appropriately separates individual and organizational variation, we examine how coding time, task scoping, and collaboration patterns affect cycle time while characterizing its substantial variability across contexts. We find precise but modest associations between cycle time and factors including coding days per week, number of merged pull requests, and degree of collaboration. However, these effects are set against considerable unexplained variation both between and within individuals. Our findings suggest that while common workplace factors do influence cycle time in expected directions, any single observation provides limited signal about typical performance. This work demonstrates methods for analyzing complex operational metrics at scale while highlighting potential pitfalls in using such measurements to drive decision-making. We conclude that improving software delivery velocity likely requires systems-level thinking rather than individual-focused interventions.

  [YZF]认为该视频只是展示了eufyMake UV打印机在中国制造和组装的过程，没有其他深层含义。这一观点的支持者主要关注视频本身的客观内容，将其视为一个对生产流程的简单展示。

data.title: Dolphin Emulator Progress Report: Release 2506
data.author: thepbone
data.article_summary:
Dolphin模拟器2506版本的进展报告介绍了几个重要更新。首先，新的**Granule Synthesis音频系统**解决了音频延迟和卡顿问题，提升了音频体验，特别是在游戏速度下降时。此外，帧数调节的改进使大多数游戏运行更加流畅，部分游戏在强大硬件支持下可突破60 FPS，但兼容性有限。Wii Speak模拟功能也终于实现，同时修复了《The Daring Game For Girls》的兼容性问题。

版本发布过程中还出现了一些问题，如2503版本的macOS构建不兼容跨平台NetPlay，以及GBA连接问题，导致需要发布热修复版本2503a。未来版本将不再对开发版本添加后缀。

Windows 10最低支持版本提升至1903，而macOS最低支持版本提升至Big Sur 11。这些变化将有助于利用新的API和功能，但也会淘汰一些旧系统版本。

44210938.article_content:
Welcome to the Dolphin Progress Report for Release 2506!  As we've alluded to a few times, we've had major changes in the pipeline that we've been very excited to show off.  Some of those changes are
finally
here!  Headlining this report are major adjustments to how Dolphin handled audio lag under slowdown by default.  No longer will users have to choose between high-latency audio stretching or popping when dealing with small hitches in performance thanks to the new Granule Synthesis Audio System.
If the game is already running full speed, we still have some improvements for you.  Dolphin has seen a suite of frame pacing improvements that will give you a smoother experience across almost every game.  And, if your system is
very
powerful, there are a select group of games that can now push past the 60 FPS barrier for high frame rate gaming.  Before you get
too
excited, this feature does not work with most Nintendo developed titles and has incredibly low compatibility in general.  For a list of what games support this, we'll get into it later in the report.
If you care about preserving oddball Wii add-ons, we've got you covered here too.  Wii Speak emulation is
finally
here after an incredibly long journey.  In addition, long time incompatible game
The Daring Game For Girls
is finally compatible with Dolphin.  We'll get into that game's story and more,
but first
, we need to get through quite a bit of housekeeping.
The Release Hotfix Fiasco
¶
We finally had some big enough problems in a release that we had to create a hotfix using our
new versioning system
. First, the macOS build for 2503 had the wrong version number attached, causing it to be incompatible with cross-platform NetPlay. We also found that GBA connectivity in compatible GameCube games was broken, and that there was a crashing bug when running Dolphin on older macOS versions. To rectify these problems, we created hotfix 2503a.  However, in doing so, we
inadvertently
caused all development builds from that point on to take the "a" suffix.  Some of our systems temporarily broke in the immediate aftermath while support for the suffix was hastily added. We technically could have removed the suffix, but we decided not to in the end because removing it would have caused even more disruption.
In future releases, if a hotfix is needed it will
not
apply a suffix to the development builds.  This should make things easier on us and anyone else that is maintaining Dolphin builds of their own.  We apologize for any inconvenience that this error has caused.
For reader convenience and future consistency, the hotfix suffix has been removed from all changes in this article.
Windows 10 minimum version bumped to 1903
¶
Although Windows 10 will reach End of Support later this year
, it continued to receive major updates up until two and a half years ago. Thanks to that, we should be able to continue supporting the decade-old operating system for many more years. However, as new APIs, standards, and compiler features appear, our minimum Windows 10 version will slowly climb.  As of
2503-152
, we are now taking advantage of time zone APIs that require Windows 10 version 1903, meaning that any older versions of Windows 10 are no longer supported.
The last Dolphin release to support Windows 10 versions 1703 to 1809 is
2503a
, and the last development build is
2503-148
.
Windows users account for ~30% of Dolphin's total userbase. 0.4% of those users are running a Windows version older than Windows 10 version 1903.
macOS minimum version bumped to macOS 11 Big Sur
¶
We have also increased our minimum macOS version from macOS 10.15 Catalina to macOS 11 Big Sur. Unfortunately, Catalina lacks support for some C++20 APIs that we'd like to take advantage of, so we decided to go ahead and bump our minimum macOS version to accommodate those changes. This bump will also allow us to (finally) update the Qt in our macOS builds to 6.5 LTS, which we will aim to do before the next release.
The last Dolphin release to support macOS 10.15 Catalina is
2503a
, and the last development build is
2503-270
.
macOS users account for ~1.3% of Dolphin's total userbase. 2.7% of those users are running a macOS version older than macOS 11 Big Sur.
Notable Changes
¶
2503-51 - Granule Synthesis Audio System
by
samb
¶
When reporting performance issues, sometimes users don't even realize that the game is slowing down. They instead report
audio hitching
or
stuttering
as the main issue that's bothering them. In order to provide low latency audio, Dolphin employs a ring buffer. And, as long as the game is running full speed, this buffer remains full and you'll get a constant stream of audio.
When the emulator is not running at the target frame rate, the buffer won't be filled up. And when Dolphin runs out of audio in the buffer, there will be a small gap in audio that sounds rather unpleasant.
The audio gaps caused by slowdown would appear to users' ears as pops and warbles.
Click to Play. File has audio.

data.author: jonbaer
data.article_summary: 本文展示了一种将多带图灵机的时间复杂度$t$模拟为空间复杂度$O(\sqrt{t \log t})$的方法，显著改进了50年前Hopcroft, Paul和Valiant提出的$O(t/\log t)$空间的模拟结果。该模拟还表明，大小为$s$的 bounded fan-in 电路可以在$\sqrt{s} \cdot poly(\log s)$空间内评估，并且存在一些问题可以在$O(n)$空间内解决，但需要$n^{2-\varepsilon}$时间，从而在$P$与$PSPACE$问题的研究上取得进展。该模拟利用了Cook和Mertz最近发现的树评估算法。文章将被发表于ACM STOC 2025。

Computer Science > Computational Complexity
arXiv:2502.17779
(cs)
[Submitted on 25 Feb 2025]
Title:
Simulating Time With Square-Root Space
Authors:
R. Ryan Williams
View a PDF of the paper titled Simulating Time With Square-Root Space, by R. Ryan Williams
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
We show that for all functions $t(n) \geq n$, every multitape Turing machine running in time $t$ can be simulated in space only $O(\sqrt{t \log t})$. This is a substantial improvement over Hopcroft, Paul, and Valiant's simulation of time $t$ in $O(t/\log t)$ space from 50 years ago [FOCS 1975, JACM 1977]. Among other results, our simulation implies that bounded fan-in circuits of size $s$ can be evaluated on any input in only $\sqrt{s} \cdot poly(\log s)$ space, and that there are explicit problems solvable in $O(n)$ space which require $n^{2-\varepsilon}$ time on a multitape Turing machine for all $\varepsilon > 0$, thereby making a little progress on the $P$ versus $PSPACE$ problem.
Our simulation reduces the problem of simulating time-bounded multitape Turing machines to a series of implicitly-defined Tree Evaluation instances with nice parameters, leveraging the remarkable space-efficient algorithm for Tree Evaluation recently found by Cook and Mertz [STOC 2024].

data.author: domofutu

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同类型的糖对2型糖尿病风险的影响是否一致

不同观点：
• **观点一**：所有糖类都会一致性地增加2型糖尿病的风险。这种观点假设所有类型的糖在代谢过程中都会以相似的方式影响血糖和胰岛素敏感性，从而增加糖尿病风险。

• **观点二**：并非所有糖类都会一致性地增加2型糖尿病的风险。domofutu引用研究结果指出，某些糖可能对糖尿病风险的影响不同于其他种类的糖，挑战了传统认为所有糖都会增加风险的假设。这表明糖的种类可能在糖尿病风险中起到关键作用。

补充讨论：
• 该讨论的核心争议在于糖的种类是否对2型糖尿病风险具有不同的影响。这涉及到对不同糖类的代谢机制的深入理解，比如葡萄糖、果糖、蔗糖等在人体中的不同作用。

• 研究结果可能引发对饮食建议的重新评估，特别是关于糖的摄入量和类型的指导。如果某些糖确实对健康影响较小，可能需要调整公共健康建议。

• 争议的焦点在于研究结果的普遍性和适用性。一些评论者可能会质疑个别研究的结果是否具有足够的证据力来推翻已有的广泛共识。

• **观点二**：并非所有糖类都会一致性地增加2型糖尿病的风险。domofutu引用研究结果指出，某些糖可能对糖尿病风险的影响不同于其他种类的糖，挑战了传统认为所有糖都会增加风险的假设。这表明糖的种类可能在糖尿病风险中起到关键作用。

补充讨论：
• 该讨论的核心争议在于糖的种类是否对2型糖尿病风险具有不同的影响。这涉及到对不同糖类的代谢机制的深入理解，比如葡萄糖、果糖、蔗糖等在人体中的不同作用。

• 研究结果可能引发对饮食建议的重新评估，特别是关于糖的摄入量和类型的指导。如果某些糖确实对健康影响较小，可能需要调整公共健康建议。

• 争议的焦点在于研究结果的普遍性和适用性。一些评论者可能会质疑个别研究的结果是否具有足够的证据力来推翻已有的广泛共识。

data.title: Too Many Open Files
data.author: furkansahin
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了一个Rust项目中遇到的“Too many open files”错误，当运行`cargo test`时出现。该错误是由于操作系统对同时打开的文件描述符数量有限制。文件描述符是Unix系统中用于标识打开文件、目录、管道、套接字和设备等的正整数。每个进程启动时默认有三个标准描述符：0（标准输入）、1（标准输出）、2（标准错误）。可通过`/dev/fd`或`/proc/<pid>/fd`查看当前进程的文件描述符。使用`lsof`命令可以列出所有打开的文件描述符，帮助排查问题。解决方法通常是关闭不必要的文件，或增加系统允许的最大文件描述符数量。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：操作系统中文件句柄数量限制的问题，特别是在Unix及类Unix系统中，文件描述符数量限制对应用程序行为的影响，以及应对该问题的不同方法。

不同观点：
• **文件句柄限制带来的实际问题**：[xorvoid]分享了一个关于应用程序因为文件描述符数量限制而崩溃的例子，特别是当使用`select()`函数时，若打开的文件数超过限制，会导致奇怪的崩溃问题。这突显了文件描述符数量限制在实际应用中的潜在影响。

• **Unix与Windows在文件句柄管理上的对比**：[jeroenhd]指出Unix系统的“一切皆文件”哲学与每个进程的文件句柄数量限制之间存在矛盾，并将其与Windows系统对比。Windows对文件句柄数量的限制更大（2^16），且因为“并非所有资源都是文件”，Windows程序在某些情况下能做更多事情。

• **解决方案：提高文件句柄限制**：
  ◦ [raggi]提供了一个在Unix系统中通过代码提高文件描述符数量限制的示例，通过调整`RLIMIT_NOFILE`来实现。
  ◦ [geocrasher]提到过去在Apache服务器上通过`ulimit`命令解决文件句柄限制的问题，并建议永久性修改配置文件。
  ◦ [database64128]提到Go语言自1.19版本起会自动提升文件描述符的软限制到硬限制，减少开发者手动调整的必要。

• **文件句柄限制问题的其他影响**：
  ◦ [a_t48]分享了一个因分析框架泄露网络连接导致文件句柄被耗尽，进而引发游戏保存失败的案例。
  ◦ [saagarjha]提到macOS系统中，沙盒应用的文件句柄限制较低且无法查询，导致在打开几千个文件后出现失败的情况。

• **关于盲目提高文件句柄限制的质疑**：[userbinator]认为，仅通过提高文件句柄限制来解决问题并不总是合理的，应该首先分析程序是否真的需要同时打开那么多文件。

补充讨论：
• **工具与命令的使用**：[Izkata]指出`lsof -p $(echo $$)`中的子shell是不必要的，可以直接使用`lsof -p $$`。
• **特定环境中的问题**：[css]提到VSCode集成终端默认设置的高文件句柄限制隐藏了问题，而在其他终端中问题暴露了出来。
• **历史对比**：[trinix912]回忆起在MS-DOS中设置`FILES=`的经历，认为文件句柄限制问题依然存在于现代系统中。[nasretdinov]也提到macOS的默认文件句柄限制较低，并提供了相关解决方案的链接。

争议焦点：
• **文件句柄限制的合理性**：部分讨论者质疑直接提高文件句柄限制是否为最佳实践，认为应该首先分析程序的需求和资源使用情况。

总结：
评论围绕Unix系统中文件句柄数量限制的问题展开，探讨了该限制对应用程序的影响、不同系统的对比、以及提高文件句柄限制的解决方案。争议点在于是否应盲目提高文件句柄限制，还是应深入分析程序的实际需求。

44201762.article_content:
Too Many Open Files
Jun 4, 2025
Discuss on HN
Recently I’ve been working on a pretty big rust project and to my surprise I
couldn’t get tests to work properly.
Running
cargo test
would start running all the tests in the repo and after a
couple of milliseconds every single test would start to fail because of an error
that I’m not very familiar with
Io(Os { code: 24, kind: Other, message: "Too many open files" })
Fortunately, the error is pretty explicit and straightfoward so I was able to
understand what was going on in a reasonable time. I’ve started digging a bit
and learned some stuff along the way.
Ever wondered how your programs juggle multiple tasks - reading files, sending
data over the network, or even just displaying text on your screen - all at
once? File descriptors are what make this all possible (in Unix systems).
At its core, a file descriptor (often abbreviated as fd) is simply a positive
integer used by the operating system kernel to identify an open file. In Unix,
"everything is a file."
Contrary to what the word says,
a file descriptor doesn’t just refer to regular files on your disk. It can
represent:
Regular files
: The documents, images, and code files you interact with daily.
Directories
: Yes, even directories are treated like files to some extent,
allowing programs to list their contents.
Pipes
: Used for inter-process communication, allowing one program’s output to
become another’s input.
Sockets
: The endpoints for network communication, whether it’s talking to a
web server or another application on your local machine.
Devices
: Hardware devices like your keyboard, mouse, and printer are also
accessed via file descriptors.
When a program wants to interact with any of these resources, it first asks the
kernel to "open" it. If successful, the kernel returns a file descriptor, which
the program then uses for all subsequent operations (reading, writing, closing,
etc.).
By convention, every Unix process starts with at least three standard file
descriptors automatically opened:
0
: Standard Input (stdin) - Typically connected to your keyboard for user
input.
1
: Standard Output (stdout) - Usually connected to your terminal for
displaying normal program output.
2
: Standard Error (stderr) - Also usually connected to your terminal, but
specifically for displaying error messages.
On macOS we can quickly check this, open your favorite terminal and run
ls
/dev/fd
.
$ ls -lah /dev/fd
Permissions Size User         Date Modified Name
crw--w----  16,2 mattrighetti  4 Jun 00:44  0
crw--w----  16,2 mattrighetti  4 Jun 00:44  1
crw--w----  16,2 mattrighetti  4 Jun 00:44  2
dr--r--r--     - root         24 May 08:23  3
On Linux we can do something similar but the repository is different and usually
follows the current pattern
/proc/<pid>/fd
. Running the same on Linux gives me this:
$ echo $$ // prints the current process id
2806524
$ sudo ls -lah /proc/2806524/fd
total 0
dr-x------ 2 root root 11 Jun  4 00:40 .
dr-xr-xr-x 9 pi   pi    0 Jun  4 00:39 ..
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 0 -> /dev/null
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 1 -> /dev/null
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 10 -> /dev/ptmx
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 11 -> /dev/ptmx
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 2 -> /dev/null
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 3 -> 'socket:[14023056]'
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 4 -> 'socket:[14023019]'
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 5 -> 'socket:[14022300]'
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 6 -> 'socket:[14023037]'
lrwx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 7 -> /dev/ptmx
l-wx------ 1 root root 64 Jun  4 00:40 8 -> /run/systemd/sessions/1501.ref
As you can see, we have
0
,
1
and
2
as expected, but we also have a bunch of
other file descriptors.
Another useful command to check for open file descriptors is
lsof
, which
stands for "list open files".
$ lsof -p $(echo $$)
COMMAND   PID         USER   FD   TYPE DEVICE SIZE/OFF                NODE NAME
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  cwd    DIR   1,17     2496              250127 /Users/mattrighetti
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17  1361200 1152921500312522433 /bin/zsh
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17    81288 1152921500312535786 /usr/share/locale/en_US.UTF-8/LC_COLLATE
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   170960 1152921500312525313 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/zutil.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   118896 1152921500312525297 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/terminfo.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   171344 1152921500312525281 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/parameter.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   135696 1152921500312525255 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/datetime.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   135568 1152921500312525291 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/stat.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   338592 1152921500312525247 /usr/lib/zsh/5.9/zsh/complete.so
zsh     39367 mattrighetti  txt    REG   1,17   136880 1152921500312525293 /usr/lib/zs

data.title: Show HN: NanoTS – Fast, embeddable, tiny time series database
data.author: dicroce
data.article_summary: NanoTS是一个高性能嵌入式时序数据库，专为实时流应用（如视频、金融、物联网传感器数据）设计。其主要特点包括：超快写入速度（SSD上8.83μs每写）、内存映射存储、可配置的持久化选项、崩溃恢复、预分配存储、支持多数据流、迭代器接口及跨平台（Linux和Windows）。它结合SQLite管理元数据和内存映射二进制文件存储数据，提供块级别的数据耐久性保障，并允许在性能和数据安全之间进行权衡。NanoTS适用于高吞吐量、低延迟场景，支持高效查找和双向迭代，特别适合视频流处理等应用。用户可根据需求配置块大小以优化性能或数据安全性。

NanoTS - High-Performance, embedded Time-Series Database
A lightweight, high-performance, embedded (like sqlite) time-series database optimized for real-time streaming applications like video, finance, and IoT sensor data.
Key Features
Ultra-fast writes
: 8.83μs per write on SSD, 300μs on spinning disk
Memory-mapped storage
: Lock free storage data structure on memory mapped file allows for maximum throughput.
Configurable durability
: Trade-off between performance and data safety with configurable block sizes
Crash recovery
: Automatic detection and recovery from unexpected shutdowns
Preallocated storage
: Preallocated storage files avoid filesystem fragmentation and administration hassles. In auto-recyle mode you always have the latest data.
Multiple streams
: Store different data streams in the same database file
Iterator interface
: Efficient navigation with bidirectional iteration and timestamp-based seeking
Cross Platform
: Currently works on Linux & Windows.
Performance
NanoTS is designed for high-throughput, low-latency applications:
113,000+ writes/second per stream
sustained on SSD
3,300+ writes/second
on spinning disk
Sub-microsecond reads
via memory mapping
Efficient seeks
using binary search on timestamps
Architecture
Storage Layout
NanoTS uses a hybrid approach combining SQLite for metadata with memory-mapped binary files for data:
┌─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┐
│File Header  │   Block 1   │   Block 2   │   Block N   │
│   (64KB)    │   (1MB+)    │   (1MB+)    │   (1MB+)    │
└─────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┘
Block size is configurable and tunable for different applications.
Each block contains:
Block header
: Metadata and frame count
Frame index
: Timestamp → offset mappings for fast seeks
Frame data
: Variable-size frames with headers and payload
Durability Guarantees
Frame-level atomicity
: Individual frames are written atomically
Block-level durability
: In worst case, lose at most one block of data during crash
Configurable trade-offs
: Smaller blocks = better durability, larger blocks = better performance
Quick Start

nanots.h

Create database with 1MB blocks, 16 total blocks

(

);

(
"

"
,

);

Create write context for a stream
auto

"

Write frames

/*

44209269.article_summary: NanoTS是一个高性能嵌入式时序数据库，专为实时流应用（如视频、金融、物联网传感器数据）设计。其主要特点包括：超快写入速度（SSD上8.83μs每写）、内存映射存储、可配置的持久化选项、崩溃恢复、预分配存储、支持多数据流、迭代器接口及跨平台（Linux和Windows）。它结合SQLite管理元数据和内存映射二进制文件存储数据，提供块级别的数据耐久性保障，并允许在性能和数据安全之间进行权衡。NanoTS适用于高吞吐量、低延迟场景，支持高效查找和双向迭代，特别适合视频流处理等应用。用户可根据需求配置块大小以优化性能或数据安全性。

data.author: EDM115
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过技术手段实现电话拨号中的DTMF信号发送，特别是在非交互式情境下的应用，以及对安全性与权限的考虑。

不同观点：
• [edent] 提出了一种技术解决方案，可以通过生成带有DTMF代码的电话链接，自动填充拨号并发送预设的DTMF信号。这种方法适用于不需要实时交互的场景，可以提前设定好拨号后的操作。
• [frankus] 认为限制任意应用直接插入电话音频可能是为了防止恶意应用与高收费服务合作，未经用户授权拨打收费电话，这是一种安全措施。
• [shawnz] 支持现有的权限管理机制，认为任意应用不应随意插入电话音频，尤其是涉及到辅助功能权限时，更应谨慎处理。
• [nancyminusone] 质疑是否生成DTMF音频并将其直接注入音频流会比现有方案更复杂，暗示可能存在技术实现上的难度。

补充讨论：
• [1970-01-01] 提供了一个现成的解决方案链接，推荐使用Google Play上的应用来实现类似功能，避免自行开发。
• [coolestguy] 建议通过修改开源操作系统中的默认拨号应用来实现真正的DTMF功能，并强制用户使用该修改版应用。
• [jeffrallen] 对底层的技术实现更感兴趣，希望看到通过系统底层调用实现DTMF发送的方案。
• [subarctic] 对DTMF进行了简单的科普，并幽默地提及流行文化，避免技术术语混淆。

争议焦点：
• 安全性与权限管理：部分评论者关注应用权限和安全性问题，担心任意应用插入电话音频可能会带来安全风险，强调需要通过辅助功能权限进行控制。
• 技术实现的复杂性与可行性：一些评论者讨论了不同技术实现方式的复杂性和可行性，包括直接生成DTMF音频与修改操作系统默认应用。

data.title: 4-7-8 Breathing
data.author: cheekyturtles
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对呼吸和冥想练习的工具、方法和技巧的讨论

不同观点：
• **推荐Plum Village应用**：[mef51] 推荐Plum Village的免费应用和YouTube频道，认为它们提供了丰富的冥想资源，并附上了链接。
• **不必拘泥于具体方法**：[kdamica] 认为不需要纠结于具体的方法，如Box breathing或Wim Hof方法，任何呼吸练习都比没有好，推荐James Nestor的《Breath》作为入门读物。
• **通过特定运动提升呼吸练习**：[dmoy] 提到通过参与3p rifle运动可以深入练习呼吸，并分享了一些相关的视频资源，指出这些技巧也可应用于音乐等其他领域。
• **UX设计问题**：[amelius] 指出应用中的一个UX问题，即在呼气时无法预见圆圈停止的位置，导致难以 mentally plan 这个阶段。
• **推荐其他应用**：[dmos62] 推荐Breathly应用，认为其视觉和听觉效果很好，并提供了自定义时间功能，但也提到希望应用能在锁屏状态下工作。
• **应用功能问题**：[PretzelPirate] 提到在使用应用时，定时器在Hold命令时停止，询问是否可以呼气，并建议定时器应为完整周期的倍数，以呼气结束。
• **技术效果的争议**：[laweijfmvo] 质疑具体技术的效果，询问是否有研究探讨在进行任务时结合Box breathing等技术的效果。
• **个人经验分享**：[JohnKemeny] 分享个人使用3-7呼吸法准备潜水经验，并描述具体步骤和效果。
• **提示音的建议**：[joleyj] 建议增加从呼气到吸气的提示音。
• **推荐其他网站**：[bix6] 推荐breathbelly.com网站，认为其展示了Box breathing和4-7-8技术。
• **反对依赖应用**：[WuxiFingerHold] 不赞成使用此类应用，认为应先学习正确的腹式呼吸，然后自然地关注呼吸，无需使用定时器或声音。
• **自然呼吸的比较**：[hankchinaski] 认为4-7-8呼吸法比Box breathing更自然，因为呼气通常比吸气时间长。
• **推荐iOS应用**：[smalio] 推荐了一款iOS应用，认为其便携且功能齐全，可在压力大的会议中使用而不被察觉。
• **循环间隔的建议**：[clocker] 建议在循环之间增加一个小间隔以作调整，认为这样可以改善应用的视觉化体验。

补充讨论：
• **4-7-8技术的解释**：[TYMorningCoffee] 解释了4-7-8呼吸技术，包括其具体步骤和放松效果，并提到该技术由Dr. Andrew Weil开发。

争议的焦点：
• **是否需要具体方法**：一些人如[kdamica]认为不需要拘泥于具体方法，任何呼吸练习都有效；而另一些人如[mef51]和[dmoy]则推荐具体的方法和资源。
• **应用的UX和功能问题**：用户对应用的功能和设计有不同意见，如[amelius]和[PretzelPirate]提到的问题和建议。
• **是否依赖应用**：[WuxiFingerHold]反对依赖应用，认为自然的呼吸练习更好；而其他用户如[dmos62]和[smalio]则推荐使用应用。

data.title: Top researchers leave Intel to build startup with 'the biggest, baddest CPU'
data.author: dangle1
data.article_summary:
《Intel顶尖研究人员离职创业，打造基于RISC-V架构的强大CPU》

AheadComputing的CEO兼联合创始人Debbie Marr在Intel工作超过三十年，曾领导几代微处理器的开发。她认为新想法必须在Intel之外实现，目标是打造基于RISC-V架构的先进CPU。RISC-V是一种开放架构，旨在通过精简指令集提高处理器效率。

AheadComputing的四位创始人在Intel共有近百年经验，现带领不足百人的团队创业，希望引领半导体技术的革新。公司已获2200万美元风投。他们认为开放标准是微处理器的未来，能使企业根据需求定制芯片。虽然产品上市还需时日，但潜在客户包括谷歌、亚马逊和三星等科技巨头。

44201072.article_content:
Top researchers leave Intel to build startup with ‘the biggest, baddest CPU’
Published:
Jun. 06, 2025, 6:15 a.m.
AheadComputing CEO and co-founder Debbie Marr spent more than three decades at Intel, helping lead development of several generations of microprocessor. But she said her latest ideas required her to start fresh: "What we want to do has to be done outside of Intel. We want to move fast, we want to take a run at RISC-V."
Mike Rogoway/The Oregonian
By
Mike Rogoway | The Oregonian/OregonLive
Together, the four founders of Beaverton startup AheadComputing spent nearly a century at Intel.
They were among Intel’s top chip architects, working years in advance to develop new generations of microprocessors to power the computers of the future.
Now they’re on their own, flying without a net, building a new class of microprocessor on an entirely different architecture from Intel’s. Founded a year ago, AheadComputing is trying to prove there’s a better way to design computer chips.
“AheadComputing is doing the biggest, baddest CPU in the world,” said Debbie Marr, the company’s CEO.
A CPU is a central processing unit, the brain inside a computer. Intel has dominated the CPU market for decades, selling processors based on an architecture the chipmaker owns, called x86.
Today, the computing ecosystem is fragmenting as new standards emerge. That’s one of the reasons Intel is struggling, as computing mainstays like Apple and Google use rival architectures to design their own chips for PCs, smartphones and data centers.
AheadComputing is betting on an open architecture called RISC-V — RISC stands for “reduced instruction set computer.” The idea is to craft a streamlined microprocessor that works more efficiently by doing fewer things, and doing them better than conventional processors.
For AheadComputing’s founders and 80 employees, many of them also Intel alumni, it’s a major break from the kind of work they’ve been doing all their careers. They’ve left a company with more than 100,000 workers to start a business with fewer than 100.
“Every person in this room,” Marr said, looking across a conference table at her colleagues, “we could have stayed at Intel. We could have continued to do very exciting things at Intel.”
They decided they had a better chance at leading a revolution in semiconductor technology at a startup than at a big, established company like Intel. And AheadComputing could be at the forefront of renewal in Oregon’s semiconductor ecosystem.
“We see this opportunity, this light,” Marr said. “We took our chances.”
Big players lose clout
Intel has been operating in Oregon since the 1970s and has long been Oregon’s largest corporate employer. It has more than 20,000 employees in Washington County, including some of the world’s top semiconductor researchers.
Very rarely, though, have any of those thousands of workers left to start their own chip business.
That’s partly because it’s prohibitively expensive for a new company to build a semiconductor factory, and partly because Intel and other tech giants controlled the essential pieces around the CPU. It was hard for newcomers to break in.
Today’s chip startups, however, don’t need their own factories. So-called fabless semiconductor designers like AheadComputing can outsource manufacturing to contractors like Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. The graphics and AI chip designer Nvidia has become a $3 trillion company — the world’s most valuable business — doing exactly that.
And AheadComputing cofounder Jonathan Pearce says the reign of the chip titans is fading as the systems that run computers break up into a series of “chiplets” from various companies, optimized for specific tasks.
“You get the opportunity for a company like AheadComputing to provide that piece of the overall system,” Pearce said. “As opposed to the past 20 years where it was just one tech giant.”
RISC-V, pronounced “Risk-five,” is especially inviting to startups because it’s an open technology, overseen by a consortium of tech firms. Unlike processors based on x86 or ARM designs, there’s no licensing fee to use RISC-V.
AheadComputing maintains that open standards are the future for microprocessors, giving technology companies more opportunity to customize chip designs to suit their specific needs.
It will be years before AheadComputing’s designs are on the market, but it envisions its chips will someday power PCs, laptops and data centers. Possible clients could include Google, Amazon, Samsung or other large computing companies.
Members of AheadComputing's executive team. From left to right: Mark Dechene (co-founder), Alon Mahl (vice president), Jonathan Pearce (co-founder), Srikanth Srinivasan (co-founder), Debbie Marr (co-founder, CEO)
Mike Rogoway/The Oregonian
That vision, and the pedigree of the Intel alumni leading the Beaverton startup, has attracted a lot of attention within the industry. AheadComputing
raised $22 million in venture capital

《Intel顶尖研究人员离职创业，打造基于RISC-V架构的强大CPU》

AheadComputing的CEO兼联合创始人Debbie Marr在Intel工作超过三十年，曾领导几代微处理器的开发。她认为新想法必须在Intel之外实现，目标是打造基于RISC-V架构的先进CPU。RISC-V是一种开放架构，旨在通过精简指令集提高处理器效率。

AheadComputing的四位创始人在Intel共有近百年经验，现带领不足百人的团队创业，希望引领半导体技术的革新。公司已获2200万美元风投。他们认为开放标准是微处理器的未来，能使企业根据需求定制芯片。虽然产品上市还需时日，但潜在客户包括谷歌、亚马逊和三星等科技巨头。
44201072.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于未来CPU设计、多核处理器的发展以及对行业现状的批评与期望

不同观点：
• [zackmorris] 支持开发具有本地内存的256-1024+核CPU，认为可以通过现代编程语言（如Erlang/Go）和工具（如GNU Octave/MATLAB）来有效管理多进程，并提出历史上如Transputers和FPGAs失败的原因是缺乏合适的编程语言和市场主流语言的竞争。他还提到Amdahl's law的限制，并暗示Rust语言的兴起是为了解决这些焦虑。

• [joshstrange] 批评了对大公司前员工创业故事的过度关注，认为这些故事往往被过度宣传，并不代表成功。他以Humane公司的失败为例，并希望OpenAI/Jony Ive的失败能打破人们对大公司背景的盲目崇拜。

• [johnklos] 强调CPU发展的遗留问题，指出为了兼容旧技术而耗费大量晶体管。他提出一种假设，如果摆脱这些遗留问题，通过更先进的设计和编译器技术，现代CPU可以获得更高的性能提升。

补充讨论：
• [kleiba] 指出在设计新型CPU时，避免专利侵权是一个实际挑战。
• [Foobar8568] 怀念20世纪80-90年代的架构多样性，希望看到类似的创新再次出现。
• [aesbetic] 认为Intel拒绝提供详细信息使得一些新项目看似噱头而非实质性进展。
• [esafak] 希望看到更多GPU的开发，而非仅仅CPU。
• [phendrenad2] 提及9个月前的相关讨论，暗示讨论主题的周期性出现。
• [ngneer] 猜测该讨论可能与Intel之前取消的Royal和Beast Lake项目有关。
• [saulpw] 和 [energy123] 讨论了公司名称和品牌选择，带有怀旧和文化评论色彩。

争议焦点：
• 是否大公司背景能保证创业成功，以及对行业内遗留技术和创新之间平衡的讨论。
• 新型CPU设计是否能真正摆脱遗留问题并实现理想性能提升，以及在实际操作中可能遇到的专利等现实问题。

data.title: Jepsen: TigerBeetle 0.16.11
data.author: aphyr
data.article_summary: TigerBeetle是一款专注于安全和速度的OLTP数据库，专为双重记账设计，基于Viewstamped Replication（VR）协议实现强可串行化一致性。它仅存储账户和转账信息，适用于金融交易等场景，通常与其他数据库结合使用。TigerBeetle针对高冲突和高吞吐量工作负载进行优化，通过单核处理所有写入操作，并采用批处理、IO并行化等技术提升性能。它非常重视容错，提供对内存、进程、时钟、存储和网络故障的明确模型，并结合VR和Protocol-Aware Recovery技术确保数据安全。TigerBeetle通过确定性模拟测试验证故障安全性，并支持自动无损升级，新旧版本二进制文件共存，确保状态机一致性。此外，TigerBeetle定义了明确的时间模型，使用VR实现逻辑时钟，并通过收集各节点的POSIX时间戳确保时间一致性。若时钟偏差超过20秒且持续超过60秒，集群将暂停请求处理。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：TigerBeetle数据库的可靠性、测试方法及其应用前景

不同观点：
• [nindalf] 认为Jepsen报告发现了一些问题，虽然可能引起关注，但TigerBeetle团队不仅修复了问题，还扩展了内部测试套件以防止未来出现类似错误，这种工程方法令人印象深刻。他预测TigerBeetle有望在十年内成为金融应用领域的默认数据库，类似于Postgres。
• [jitl] 对TigerBeetle通过Jepsen验证其声明感到高兴，但对如何在实际应用中与其他系统协同工作提出疑问，尤其是如何从一致性问题中恢复。
• [DetroitThrow] 指出Jepsen报告中提到的段错误问题，认为如果使用Rust等内存安全语言可能会避免此类问题，从而证明TigerBeetle采用Zig语言的有效性。
• [FlyingSnake] 对Jepsen报告的详细性表示赞赏，并期待TigerBeetle未来的发展，尽管尚未达到1.0版本。
• [ryeats] 认为分布式系统测试中使用系统实际发生的时间而非墙上时钟时间是显而易见但有趣的见解。
• [eevmanu] 对Jepsen和Antithesis测试套件的区别和各自优势提出疑问，希望了解为何Jepsen发现了Antithesis未检测到的问题，并列出几种可能性和假设。

补充讨论：
• [koakuma-chan] 好奇是否有大银行或证券交易所使用TigerBeetle。
• [ManBeardPc] 对TigerBeetle客户端文档中缺少C或Zig客户端表示关注。
• [andyferris] 对TigerBeetle模型中假设整个磁盘扇区错误而非比特/字节错误表示兴趣，并分享了他在错误纠正编码方面的经验。
• [wiradikusuma] 提到TigerBeetle是否对生产环境收费的问题，尽管未能找到定价页面。
• [cmrdporcupine] 指出Jepsen报告中链接损坏的问题，并提供了正确的链接。
• [Ygg2] 认为TigerBeetle虽然 impressive，但由于其单一用途的数据库模型，限制了其在不符合账簿模型的应用中的使用。

争议焦点：
• Jepsen和Antithesis测试套件的区别和各自的优势，尤其是为何Jepsen发现了Antithesis未检测到的问题，这是[eevmanu]提出的核心问题，引发了对两种测试方法的比较和讨论。

总结：
评论主要围绕TigerBeetle的可靠性、测试方法及其在实际应用中的潜力和限制展开。不同评论者对Jepsen验证结果的积极意义表示赞赏，同时对其在实际应用中的一致性和与其他系统的协同工作提出了疑问和建议。此外，关于Jepsen和Antithesis测试套件的比较也是一个重要的讨论点。

44199592.article_content:
1
Background
TigerBeetle is an
Online Transactional Processing (OLTP)
database built for double-entry accounting with a strong emphasis on safety and speed. It builds on the
Viewstamped Replication (VR)
consensus protocol to offer
Strong Serializable
consistency. Unlike general-purpose databases, TigerBeetle stores only accounts and transfers between them. This data model is well-suited for financial transactions, inventory, ticketing, or utility metering. To store other kinds of information, users typically pair TigerBeetle with other databases, linking them through user-defined identifiers.
TigerBeetle optimizes for
high-contention and high-throughput workloads
, such as central bank switches or brokerages. A central bank exchange might have only a half-dozen to a few hundred account recordsâone for each partner bankâand process
hundreds of millions
of
transactions per day
between 647 banks. A large brokerage, after the trading day closes, might need to settle the entire dayâs trades as quickly as possible.
1
These trades also tend to be concentrated on a small number of popular stocks. Under high contention, per-object concurrency control mechanisms can be the limiting factor in throughput. Instead, TigerBeetle funnels all writes through
a single core on the primary VR node
. This limits throughput to whatever a single node can execute: TigerBeetle is firmly scale-up, not scale-out. To make that single node as fast as possible, TigerBeetle makes extensive use of batching, IO parallelization, a fixed schema, and hardware-friendly optimizationsâsuch as fixed-size, cache-aligned data structures.
Refreshingly, TigerBeetle stresses fault tolerance in their marketing and documentation. They offer
explicit models
for memory, process, clock, storage, and network faults. ECC RAM is assumed to be correct. Processes may pause or crash. Clocks may jump forward and backward in time. Disks are assumed to not only fail completely, but to tear individual writes or corrupt data. Networks may delay, drop, duplicate, misdirect, and corrupt messages. To mitigate these faults, TigerBeetle combines Viewstamped Replication with techniques from
Protocol-Aware Recovery
, uses extensive checksums stored separately from data blocks, and for critical data, writes and reads multiple copies. TigerBeetle also makes extensive use of runtime correctness assertions to identify and limit the damage from faults and bugs alike.
Unlike most distributed systems, TigerBeetle claims to keep running without data loss
if even a single replica retains a copy
of a record:
A record would need to get corrupted on all replicas in a cluster to get lost, and even in that case the system would safely halt.
To test safety under faults, TigerBeetle employs
deterministic simulation testing
: tests which perform reproducible, pseudo-random operations against the system and ensure that some property holds.
2
The
Viewstamped Operation Replicator (VOPR)
test simulates an entire TigerBeetle cluster, including clock, disk, and network interfaces. It simulates clock skew, corrupts reads and writes, loses and reorders network messages, and so on. There are other simulation tests which stress specific subsystems, as well as
a variety of more traditional integration and unit tests
.
TigerBeetle also offers a noteworthy approach to upgrades. Each TigerBeetle binary includes the code not just for that particular version, but several previous versions. For example, the 0.16.21 binary can run 0.16.17, 0.16.18, and so on through 0.16.21. To upgrade, one simply
replaces the binary on disk
. TigerBeetle loads the new binary, but continues running with the current version. It then coordinates across the cluster to smoothly roll out each successive version, until all nodes are running the latest version available. This approach does not require operators to carefully sequence the upgrade process. Instead, upgrades are performed automatically, and coupled to the replicated state machine. This also allows TigerBeetle to ensure that an operation which commits on version
x
will never commit on any other versionâguarding against state divergence.
1.1
Time
TigerBeetle defines an
explicit model of time
. Viewstamped Replication forms a totally ordered sequence of state transitions, and its view and op numbers can be used as a totally ordered logical clock. Financial systems usually prefer wall clocks, so most TigerBeetle timestamps are in âphysical time,â which, like
Hybrid Logical Clocks
, approximate POSIX time with stronger ordering guarantees. Specifically, TigerBeetle leaders
collect POSIX timestamps
from all replicas
3
and try to find a time which falls within a reasonable margin of error across a quorum of nodes.
4
Those timestamps are incorporated into the VR-replicated state machine, and constrained to be strictly monotonic. When no quorum of clocks falls within a
twenty-second window
for longer than sixty seconds, the cluster refuses requests until clocks com

data.title: Should I Use a Carousel? (2013)
data.author: coffeecoders
data.article_summary: 本文强烈反对在网页上使用轮播图（carousel）。多项数据和专家意见表明，用户很少点击轮播图，点击第一位置的比例高达89%，而整体点击率仅1%。尼尔森 Norman 集团等研究表明，轮播图并不是展示首页内容的有效方式，用户常常忽略其中的内容，且轮播图还存在键盘和屏幕阅读器用户的访问障碍。专家建议避免使用轮播图，认为它们只是为了满足市场或管理层需求，而非提升用户体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户交互设计中被认为是糟糕实践的元素及其使用问题

不同观点：
• [davidkellis] 认为有些用户交互方式通常被视为不好的实践，比如Toasts和Modals。他提供了相关文章和视频来支持其观点，指出这些元素可能会被过度使用，尽管在某些情况下有其适用性。
   
• [burnhamup] 同意[davidkellis]的观点，并通过个人经历说明自动轮播的图片滑块（carousel）因其持续移动而影响阅读体验，强调了这种设计的不便。

• [mdaniel] 提到他曾预期页面会像"isfirefoxfastyet"风格那样简单粗暴地显示"no"，但发现信息被隐藏在第二页的轮播中，认为这种方式进一步传达了信息。

• [ofalkaed] 对carousels有不同的情感反应，表示这种设计让他怀念过去的使用体验，带有一定的怀旧情感。

• [Groxx] 对carousels被纳入CSS标准表示遗憾，并将此归因于Google，引用了一篇请求Google改变的文章来支持其立场。

• [waltbosz] 指出carousels这种设计趋势似乎已经过时，最近很少见到，暗示这种设计已经逐渐退出流行。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点主要集中在carousels和toasts、modals等交互设计元素是否为不良用户体验实践。部分用户如[burnhamup]和[davidkellis]认为这些设计元素在使用中存在问题，而[ofalkaed]则带有怀旧情绪，[Groxx]对carousels被纳入标准感到不满。

• 提供的链接资源为讨论提供了更多的背景信息和深度分析，帮助理解这些设计元素为何被视为不好的实践。

data.article_summary: 本文探讨了利用强化学习训练大型语言模型（LLMs）来解释人类决策的可能性。传统神经网络模型虽然预测性能强，但解释能力弱。作者通过基于结果的奖励强化学习，引导LLMs生成合理的解释，成功实现了对人类风险选择的准确预测和高质量解释。这表明LLMs可以兼具精准预测和可解释性，为认知建模提供了新思路。

Authors:

View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
A central goal of cognitive modeling is to develop models that not only predict human behavior but also provide insight into the underlying cognitive mechanisms. While neural network models trained on large-scale behavioral data often achieve strong predictive performance, they typically fall short in offering interpretable explanations of the cognitive processes they capture. In this work, we explore the potential of pretrained large language models (LLMs) to serve as dual-purpose cognitive models--capable of both accurate prediction and interpretable explanation in natural language. Specifically, we employ reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards to guide LLMs toward generating explicit reasoning traces for explaining human risky choices. Our findings demonstrate that this approach produces high-quality explanations alongside strong quantitative predictions of human decisions.

data.title: An innovative superfamily of fonts for code (2023)
data.author: laex
data.article_summary: Monaspace是一套创新的代码字体系统，旨在提升代码显示的质量。自打字机时代以来，代码一直使用等宽字体，但其显示效果存在不均匀的纹理问题。Monaspace通过"纹理修复"技术解决这一问题，使字符密度更均匀，同时保持等宽网格。该技术利用OpenType的“上下文替换”功能，在不需新软件或插件的情况下适配大多数编辑器。此外，Monaspace还提供多种字体风格和自定义选项，旨在为代码和开发工具提供更丰富的表达方式，改善开发者的编码体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：字体选择及其在编程环境中的适用性，特别是针对不同字体在可读性、美观性、特殊字符区分、CJK支持等方面的讨论。

不同观点：
• **KronisLV** 推荐了Liberation Mono、Google Cousine和PT Mono，认为这些字体在小字号下的可读性较好，但对Terminus字体在特定大小下表现不佳表示失望。最终选择了JetBrains Mono，因为其免费且易于在多个IDE中设置。同时，也开始关注浅色/深色主题对生产力的影响。

• **0x69420** 深入分析了多种字体，包括Radon、Krypton、Xenon、Argon和Neon。他们认为Argon面临同类字体的激烈竞争，而Neon则因其易读性而受到青睐。同时指出Argon的比例过宽，而大多数压缩字体如Iosevka和Pragmata则显得模糊。建议可以尝试将Monaspace的宽度缩放到超窄范围。

• **RadiozRadioz** 指出了在多种字体中，"Krypton"之外的字体中数字1和小写l几乎无法区分的问题，这可能会影响代码的可读性。

• **danhau** 对Iosevka的斜体字情有独钟，认为其表现优异，并梦想有一款结合Berkeley Mono和Iosevka斜体的字体。

• **tmtvl** 强调了CJK（中日韩）字符支持的重要性，并因此选择IBM Plex，因为其他选项如Adobe的Source和Google的Noto在某些情况下表现不佳。

• **9d** 描述了自己从自制字体crt34到使用Fira Code的经历，认为Fira Code的渲染效果非常好，并且迅速适应了该字体。

• **ac130kz** 选择了Monaspace Argon作为默认字体，认为其在可读性上略优于JetBrains Mono，且没有过于花哨。

• **BugsJustFindMe** 批评了Radon字体中手写体的小写l和 uppercase Z难以区分的问题，认为这种明显的符号模糊性使得该字体不适合用于代码编写。

补充讨论：
• **9d** 在后续评论中对多种字体表示赞赏，并计划在未来5天内尝试使用这些字体，从Radon开始。

• **ChrisArchitect** 提供了有关Monaspace字体的背景信息，包括其初始发布和最新版本1.2中的Nerd Fonts等内容。

争议焦点：
• 字体在小字号下的可读性以及特定字符（如1和l）的区分度是主要争议点。
• 不同字体在宽度、压缩比例和CJK支持方面的表现也是讨论中的重要分歧点。

总结：用户们在字体的可读性、美观性、特殊字符区分、CJK支持等方面提出了各自的见解和偏好，同时对多种字体进行了详细的分析和比较。

Since the earliest days of the teletype machine, code has been set in monospaced type
—
letters, on a grid. Monaspace is a new type system that advances the state of the art for the display of code on screen.
Every advancement in the technology of computing has been accompanied by advancements to the display and editing of code. CRTs made screen editors possible. The advent of graphical user interfaces gave rise to integrated development environments.
Even today, we still have limited options when we want to layer additional meaning on top of code. Syntax highlighting was invented in 1982 to help children to code in BASIC. But beyond colors, most editors must communicate with developers through their interfaces
—
hovers, underlines, and other graphical decorations.
Monaspace offers a more expressive palette for code and the tools we use to work with it.

Monospaced type suffers from an inherent problem of uneven texture
—
text with some areas that are significantly denser, and some that have an excess of whitespace. It’s an unavoidable consequence of trying to fit every letter into a uniform box, when some letters want more space, and some want less.
These shortcomings have been the same since the heyday of the Teletype machine in the 1960s. Texture Healing is a novel technique that evens out the density of monospaced type, bringing it closer to how proportional type has looked for centuries.
Texture healing preserves the monospace grid, and works in most editors without needing new software or editor plugins.
How does it work?

In proportional typefaces, every glyph is designed with a unique width.
The design of an
m
can be wider than the design of an
i
. Every glyph gets the space it needs, and no letter is stuck with too much or too little.
The design of each letter incorporates some amount of whitespace on both sides of a glyph.
These sidebearings create the visual room that help us distinguish one letterform from the next
.
Too little, and the letters will run together. Too much, and the letters will look disconnected.
But in monospaced faces, every letter must be the same width, regardless of what that letter needs.
Adjusting the sidebearings isn’t enough.
The letter must be altered to either fill up the box, or squeeze into it
—
and still leave a little bit of room for sidebearings.
Narrow letters like
l
and
i
must be designed with exaggerated serifs to better fill the monospace box. Even with these synthetic additions,
these narrow letters have more space than they need.
Wide letters like
m
and
w
are crammed into their boxes, and their shapes are visibly distorted compared to the rest of the alphabet. Their strokes are thinner, and the negative space inside the glyph is also compromised. There’s little room for these glyphs to grow bolder without turning into an unreadable blob.
Even though these letters have less space than they want, they still need to leave some room for sidebearings so they don’t crowd the adjacent letters.

Texture healing works by finding each pair of adjacent characters where one wants more space, and one has too much. Narrow characters are swapped for ones that cede some of their whitespace, and wider characters are swapped for ones that extend to the very edge of their box. This swapping is powered by an OpenType feature called “contextual alternates,” which is widely supported by both operating systems and browser engines.
Contextual alternates are normally used for certain scripts, like Arabic, where the shape of each glyph depends on the surrounding glyphs. And they are also used for cursive handwriting font

data.title: Show HN: AI game animation sprite generator
data.author: lyogavin
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一款强大的AI精灵生成器，用户可以通过上传角色设计图或文字描述，快速生成高质量的游戏动画精灵。该工具支持多种动作类型和艺术风格，提供透明背景和精准的边界框，适用于游戏开发的各个阶段。用户还可以免费训练自定义动作模型，并选择将其设为私密或公开。生成精灵需要 credits，购买后永久有效，无需订阅。不同套餐提供不同数量的 credits，适合各种需求的用户。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成艺术工具的应用、技术实现、伦理问题及实际效果

不同观点：
• [积极评价] **DoctorPangloss** 认为工具的重点在于产品功能如定价和演示，但指出对艺术家和游戏开发者而言，这些并非核心关注。他建议通过开源或免费来增加工具的真实性和吸引力。
• **Palmfacehn** 对工具的进展表示赞赏，并提出生成游戏世界时对装备和武器互换性的技术需求，建议通过训练模型避免穿模问题。
• **MasterScrat** 祝贺产品发布，并对机器学习方面的技术细节表示兴趣，关注模型成本与质量的权衡及开源与闭源模型的比较。

补充讨论：
• [实用性争议] **Cloudef** 指出工具生成的结果需要大量手动编辑才能使用，且动画例子多取自现有作品（如街头霸王），质疑其是否达到专业质量。
• **Bigcat12345678** 遇到支付后积分消失及队列任务丢失的技术问题，要求客服解决。
• **Zoba** 询问类似工具，用于生成俯视RPG游戏的tilesets，指出Midjourney等工具无法直接用于游戏开发。

技术细节与伦理问题：
• **Elpocko** 关注工具使用的模型及其开源性，质疑未公开模型细节及GitHub链接问题。
• **Nkrisc** 提出伦理问题，认为AI工具利用现有艺术家的作品生成图像是不道德的，除非训练材料为自建。

其他意见：
• **Sambeau** 对工具的某些生成结果（如女性忍者长出男性生殖器）表示不满和困惑。
• **Akritrime** 询问工具是否使用OpenAI的GPT-image或其他类似技术。
• **Bitwize** 认为AI在动画领域的应用可以减轻人工绘制中间帧的繁琐工作，有利于独立创作者。
• **Iandanforth** 对工具生成动画（如史莱姆动画）的能力表示怀疑，基于以往尝试其他AI工具的经验提出问题。

争议焦点：
• 工具的实用性与质量：是否真正达到专业使用标准，是否需要大量手动编辑。
• 伦理问题：工具使用现有艺术家作品进行训练的正当性。

补充讨论：
• 技术可行性与改进建议：如装备互换性、穿模问题解决、模型公开性等。

data.title: Trump deploys National Guard as Los Angeles protests against immigration agents
data.author: colinprince
data.article_summary: 美国总统特朗普签署命令，派遣2000名国民警卫队队员至洛杉矶以驱散因反对移民突袭而引发的抗议。抗议活动中使用了催泪弹和闪光弹，并有四人被捕。白宫称此举旨在应对“非法犯罪入侵”，而加州州长纽森批评此举只会加剧紧张局势。洛杉矶市长巴斯表示，社区因联邦移民行动感到恐慌，并正与执法部门合作寻找解决方案。抗议者和执法部门之间发生了冲突，洛杉矶警察局与ICE就响应速度问题各执一词。抗议始于周五，此前ICE在突袭行动中逮捕了44人，引发了大规模混乱。

• **andrewinardeer** 的观点：国民警卫队的一个职能是应总统要求平息国内动乱，质疑这次是否也是这种情况，暗示对国民警卫队出动动机的怀疑。

• **russellbeattie** 的观点：建议抗议者学习乌克兰的策略，使用无人机进行非暴力抗议，例如投放闪光弹、水气球、涂料、橡胶球、 silly string（恶搞彩带）等，强调这种行动的娱乐性和潜在的传播效果，特别是通过TikTok等社交媒体。

44214230.article_content:
Navigation for News Categories
By
Karina Tsui
and
Zoe Sottile
, CNN
A person holding a poster "Kidnapped by ICE".
Photo:
AFP/KENA BETANCUR
US President Donald Trump has signed a presidential memorandum deploying 2000 National Guardsmen to Los Angeles to disperse protests that began in response to immigration raids, the White House said in a statement.
Tear gas and flash bangs were used to disperse protesters in Paramount, California on Saturday (local time) and four people were arrested, according to Assemblymember José Luis Solache.
"These operations are essential to halting and reversing the invasion of illegal criminals into the United States. In the wake of this violence, California's feckless Democrat leaders have completely abdicated their responsibility to protect their citizens," White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said in a statement
California Gov. Gavin Newsom called the move "purposefully inflammatory" and said it would only escalate tensions.
"This is the wrong mission and will erode public trust," Newsom said.
Leavitt argued that Trump called in the guardsmen to "address the lawlessness that has been allowed to fester" and "violent mobs attacked ICE Officers and Federal Law Enforcement Agents."
FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino said Saturday on social media the bureau was investigating alleged instances of Los Angeles demonstrators obstructing immigration enforcement operations.
The White House's move is facing criticism from some in law enforcement. Many see the deployment of the National Guard as an overreaction that may backfire and only provoke additional agitators, one senior law enforcement source involved in responding to the Los Angeles protests said.
Dozens of potentially violent demonstrators were observed by law enforcement around Los Angeles as of Saturday evening and law enforcement officers were actively working to bring them under control, according to the source.
Stephen Miller, the White House deputy chief of staff, said the government has two choices: "Deport the invaders, or surrender to insurrection."
Others in the Trump administration also weighed in. "Insurrectionists carrying foreign flags are attacking immigration enforcement officers, while one half of America's political leadership has decided that border enforcement is evil," Vice President JD Vance said in a post on X Saturday night.
Mayor Karen Bass said many in Los Angeles County are fearful following recent federal immigration enforcement actions. She added that reports of "unrest" are "deeply concerning."
"We've been in direct contact with officials in Washington, D.C., and are working closely with law enforcement to find the best path forward," Bass said in a statement Saturday night. "Everyone has the right to peacefully protest, but let me be clear: violence and destruction are unacceptable, and those responsible will be held accountable."
Karen Bass.
Photo:
AFP
The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department said it was working to ensure the safety of the public by managing traffic and controlling crowds.
The response to the protests drew a conflict between ICE and the Los Angeles Police Department. "Our brave officers were vastly outnumbered, as over 1000 rioters surrounded and attacked a federal building," said ICE in a statement. "It took over two hours for the Los Angeles Police Department to respond, despite being called multiple times."
But the LAPD said that, "Contrary to the claim that LAPD delayed its response for over two hours, our personnel mobilised and acted as swiftly as conditions safely allowed."
Protests started Friday
The protests started Friday afternoon. Police on Friday night issued a citywide tactical alert nearly two hours after declaring protests across the downtown area unlawful assemblies. "The use of less lethal munitions has been authorised by the Incident Commander," LAPD's Central Division wrote in a post on X.
Videos of the scene show law enforcement officers in riot gear, wielding batons, holding shields and throwing smoke bombs into the crowd. Protesters chanted "Free them all" and held signs with messages including "Full Rights for All Immigrants" and "Stop the Deportations." Video shows several officers in riot gear pinning at least one person to the ground.
The protest came after at least 44 people were arrested by federal immigration agents earlier in the day, The Associated Press reported, after Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers executed search warrants at three locations, according to a spokesperson for Homeland Security Investigations. The arrests come amid Trump's crackdown on immigration, which has involved waves of raids and deportations across the country.
Bass, the Los Angeles mayor, characterized the immigration arrests as "mass chaos," according to CNN affiliate KABC. The mayor said she hadn't been told about the raids in advance. "It sows a sense of terror throughout the community," she said. "ICE was literally chasing people down the street."

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：个人价值观和生活重点的多元化

不同观点：
• **技术和用户体验的平衡**：[THENATHE] 强调技术产品应注重核心功能的可靠性和耐用性，反对过度依赖奢侈功能和广告。他们以汽车手动调节座椅为例，认为如果某个功能损坏会导致整个产品无法使用，那么该功能应尽量简单和耐用。同时，他们认为某些奢侈功能（如座椅冷却）即使损坏也不影响产品基本使用。

• **知识与智慧的体现**：[andrei_says_] 认为知识不仅仅是理解，还包括体现和智慧。他们强调同意与尊重、善良作为默认行为、关怀超越交易关系，以及艺术作为表达和治疗的方式。

• **美的追求**：[omosubi] 强调美在生活中的重要性，认为周围环境中的丑陋让他们感到痛苦，几乎所有东西都可以变得更加美丽。

• **个人责任感**：[SemioticStandrd] 简单直接地提出个人责任感是他们关注的核心价值。

• **生命和家庭责任**：[BirAdam] 强调生命本身的重要性，包括如何处理烦人的生物如蚊子、细菌和寄生虫，并提到努力成为更好的父亲和丈夫的挑战。

• **行善和关系**：[relyks] 认为行善和让世界变得更好、建立良好的关系、解决有趣的问题、智力的成长是他们关注的重点。

• **善良与产品设计**：[stonecharioteer] 强调善良对待同事、朋友和家人，认为这种态度会反映在产品中，使其对用户和顾客更加友善。

• **沟通的失效**：[ofalkaed] 认为现代沟通大多是单向的，充满了自我中心的问题，如“我能从中得到什么？”。他们认为这种现象不能完全归咎于互联网，早在20世纪80年代就有类似问题。

• **数学与善良**：[welcome_dragon] 简单地提到数学和善良是他们关注的重点。

• **家庭与朋友**：[mradek] 强调父母、宠物和朋友的重要性。

• **社会包容性的缺乏**：[add-sub-mul-div] 认为很多问题源于近半数人口对不同人群和实践的恐惧，解决这一根本问题才能有效改善其他问题。

• **多重价值的平衡**：[spiderfarmer] 列举了多个关注点，包括妻子、孩子、家庭、房子、同理心、善良、平等、可用性和设计/美。

• **互动的重要性**：[9d] 简单提到互动是他们关注的重点。

补充讨论：
- 评论中存在对技术产品设计中功能平衡的不同看法，尤其是核心功能与奢侈功能的对比。
- 多个评论强调善良和同理心作为个人和产品设计的重要价值。
- 有争议的焦点可能在于沟通问题的根源，[ofalkaed] 认为现代沟通问题并不完全归因于互联网，而是有更深的文化背景。
- 社会包容性和个人责任感也是讨论中涉及的重要社会议题。

data.article_summary: Sandia National Labs和德国公司SpiNNcloud合作推出了SpiNNaker2超级计算机，该计算机受大脑神经网络启发，旨在用于国家核威慑任务。SpiNNaker2采用高度并行架构，无GPU和内部存储，依赖SRAM和DRAM进行高速数据处理，通过高速芯片间通信消除了对集中存储的需求。该系统每块服务器板有48个SpiNNaker2芯片，共152个内核和专用加速器，单板内存达96GB。Sandia采购的系统包含24块板，共17.5万个内核，连接至现有HPC系统，无操作系统和磁盘，通过以太网端口加载和保存数据。SpiNNaker2能够模拟1.5至1.8亿个神经元，具有高效能和事件驱动计算能力，适用于国防和安全领域的高计算需求。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：神经形态计算及其相关硬件架构（SpiNNcloud Systems和SpiNNaker 2）的技术细节、实用性、编程难度以及能源效率等方面的评价和争议。

不同观点：

• **对文章和技术的赞赏**  
  - [patcon] 认为该文章极具影响力，作者像是默默无闻的天才，其思想对未来科学有深远影响，尤其是在DARPA的工作背景下。该评论表达了对神经形态计算和热力学计算融合的兴奋和期待。

• **对SpiNNcloud Systems的质疑**  
  - [GregarianChild] 质疑SpiNNcloud Systems的营销方式，认为其声称与DeepMind、Meta等公司有合作的宣传存在误导性。还对能源效率的比较（如与GPU的比较）提出怀疑。此外，他关心该机器的编程难度，尤其是对主流框架（如JAX、TensorFlow和PyTorch）的支持。

• **对架构可实现性的担忧**  
  - [bob1029] 指出，在模拟尖峰神经网络时，处理严格的因果关系是巨大挑战，若处理不当可能导致模拟失真。他还提到，尽管分布式和非确定性架构可能成功，但这是非常困难的挑战，应该先解决更容易的问题。

• **技术细节的讨论**  
  - [marsten] 认为SpiNNaker 2的架构与GPU集群类似，并讨论了内存和网络架构的具体实现细节，如SRAM、DRAM和网络连接方式，还提到了是否使用HBM和内存访问优化。

• **对传统计算架构的批评**  
  - [mikewarot] 批评了冯·诺依曼架构的效率问题，认为未来计算将更多依赖FPGA的进化，并指出存储和计算的分离是浪费资源的表现。

• **实际应用案例**  
  - [latchkey] 分享了使用PS5 APU构建计算集群的实际案例，尽管遇到了内存非ECC导致随机失败的问题，但最终成功实现。

• **对信息不足的抱怨**  
  - [timmg] 认为文章没有提供足够的信息来理解该技术的用途和工作原理。

• **对存储和RAM的混淆**  
  - [realo] 和 [shrubble] 对“无存储”的描述感到困惑，因为该系统仍然有大量RAM。

• **对硬件意图和应用的解释**  
  - [HarHarVeryFunny] 解释该硬件最初目的是实时模拟大型尖峰神经网络，但实际上更多用于事件驱动模拟和国防应用。

• **对神经形态架构的宏观看法**  
  - [rahen] 认为该硬件标志着从传统CPU架构向神经形态架构的重大转变，暗示着整个计算范式的转变。

• **对生物启发式命名的批评**  
  - [anArbitraryOne] 认为生物启发式的命名过于泛滥，建议更准确的命名方式，避免误导。

• **对实际可行性的怀疑**  
  - [dedicate] 质疑该系统是否只是将一个瓶颈换成另一个，并担心其对电源的依赖和实际可行性。

• **对技术用途的调侃**  
  - [1970-01-01] 调侃该技术最终可能会被用于挖比特币，而非科研。

• **对“脑类似”描述的困惑**  
  - [hackyhacky] 质疑“脑类似”的描述，认为文章没有提供足够证据支持这一点，并质疑该机器的实际优势。

补充讨论：
- 神经形态计算的编程难度和实际应用场景是讨论的焦点之一。
- 对SpiNNcloud Systems的营销方式和能源效率的质疑反映了技术社区对夸大宣传的敏感。
- 对冯·诺依曼架构的批评和对FPGA的看好反映了计算架构的未来发展方向的不同看法。
- 对“脑类似”描述的困惑和质疑反映了技术命名和实际技术特性之间的差距。

Brad Theilman facing camera, and Felix Wang, background, unpack a new shipment of the SpiNNaker2 computing core.  It is a collaboration between Sandia and SpiNNcloud and will be the first in world commercial product from the cooperation.
Funded through NNSA’s Advanced Simulation and Computing (ASC) program, this work will explore how neuromorphic computing can be leveraged for the nation’s nuclear deterrence missions.
SpiNNaker is a contraction of ‘Spiking Neural Network Architecture,’ which is a brain inspired neuromorphic computer for large-scale, real-time modeling of brain-like applications. This technology can simulate large brain-like networks to enhance researchers’ understanding of the brain, as well as provide a framework to test the boundaries of current computing capabilities.
Photo by Craig Fritz
Sandia National Labs has flipped the switch on its SpiNNaker 2 “brain-inspired” supercomputer that eschews both GPUs and internal storage.
The system, supplied by Germany-based SpiNNcloud, will rank amongst the top five “brain inspired” platforms, mimicking between 150 and 180 million neurons.
The architecture was initially
developed
by Arm pioneer Steve Furber, though it still falls somewhat short of the human brain’s 100 billion neurons.
As SpiNNcloud explains it, the SpiNNaker 2’s highly parallel architecture has 48 SpiNNaker 2 chips per server board, each of which in turn carries 152 based cores and specialized accelerators.
Each of the 48 chips packs 20 MB of SRAM, with each board carrying 96 GB of external LPDDR4 external memory. So, with 90 boards, that amounts to 8640 GB of DRAM, while a 1440 board system carries 69,120 chips and 138240 TB of DRAM.
Needless to say, the system uses high-speed chip to chip communication. And this, SpiNNcloud says, eliminates the need for centralized storage. That, and the vast amount of memory.
Speeding on DRAM
In Sandia’s case, it has taken delivery of a 24 board, 175,000 core system. At
Sandia
, according to
SpiNNcloud
, “The Supercomputer is hooked in to existing HPC systems and does not contain any OS or disks. The speed is generated by keeping data in the SRAM and DRAM.”
Standard parallel ethernet ports are “sufficient for loading/saving the data.”  The “current maximum system” is over 10.5m cores, which SpiNNcloud says means it can maintain biological real time.
Moreover, it allows complex event-driven compute and simulations with more power efficiency compared to GPU systems.
Hector A. Gonzalez, co-founder and CEO of SpiNNcloud, said the system would be targeted at problems in “next generation defense and beyond. The SpiNNaker2’s efficiency gains make it particularly well-suited for the demanding computational needs of national security applications.”

data.title: What you need to know about EMP weapons
data.author: flyingkiwi44
data.article_summary: 《Aardvark Daily》文章讨论了电磁脉冲（EMP）武器的破坏效应，特别是在核爆高空产生的EMP对电子设备的严重影响。文章介绍了EMP产生的三个阶段：E1阶段产生极高频电磁脉冲，能瞬间损坏电子设备；E2阶段频率降低，持续时间较长，但较易防护；E3阶段频率更低，持续数分钟到数十分钟，可能对长导线和电力基础设施造成损害。为防护EMP，文章建议使用多层导电材料构成的法拉第笼，确保无缝隙且设备完全封闭，不留下任何能量进入的路径。核爆在地面或近地面产生的EMP较弱，高空爆炸才能最大化EMP效应。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：高空核爆电磁脉冲（EMP）的影响及其防护措施的可行性与真实性

不同观点：
• [ufmace] 认为大多数关于高空核EMP的文章和故事都是基于外行人的猜测和灾难幻想，缺乏实际实验或可靠来源支持。他指出，大多数严肃的实验可能由各国军方进行且高度机密，同时质疑文章作者的资质和内容的可靠性。
• [tomxor] 讨论了自己尝试用铝箔屏蔽高频信号（如2.4GHz WiFi）的实验，指出简单的折叠无法有效防止信号传播，需要多层随机重叠和皱褶才能有效阻挡信号。他怀疑这种方法是否对EMP有效。
• [nancyminusone] 对文章中缺乏具体参数表示不满，提出需要明确的频率、电流大小和距离等数据才能做出准确判断，否则无法相信文章的结论。
• [lenerdenator] 持简单态度，认为如果核爆发生，人们将面临更大的问题，不必过于担心EMP。
• [amit9gupta] 推荐了一本关于核战争的书，认为政治家和军工复合体受益者应阅读此类书籍以了解核战争的后果。
• [cogogo] 提到了一部涉及EMP的阿根廷科幻剧集，认为其质量很高，值得观看。
• [PaulHoule] 提供了关于核EMP如何通过伽马射线电离大气层产生强电磁场的科学解释，并引用了维基百科的相关资料。
• [tronicjester] 提到YouTube因核战争相关内容删除了关于法拉第笼的视频。
• [hollerith] 对仅凭意见文章判断事实表示怀疑，倾向于等待事实信息。
• [amelius] 提出一个实际问题，即需要多少层铝箔才能有效防护EMP。
• [ctippett] 询问商用飞机在核爆EMP影响下的安全性问题，质疑飞机是否会失去所有电子设备。
• [mikewarot] 认为现代电子设备由于严格的射频发射规定和良好的屏蔽措施，大多数应能抵抗EMP，除了某些特殊设备如HF业余无线电。
• [timcobb] 对当前可能面临的核冲突表示担忧，询问是否应感到害怕。
• [mrbluecoat] 推荐了一本名为《One Second After》的书，认为其对EMP后果有深刻的描写。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于高空核EMP的真实影响和普通人的防护能力，缺乏具体科学数据支持使得讨论多基于猜测和理论。
• 读者对文章作者的资质和内容的可信度提出质疑，强调需要可靠的实验和数据支撑。
• 有人关注实际应用中的问题，如商用飞机的安全性和具体防护措施的有效性。
• 讨论中多次提到科幻作品和影视剧，反映出大众文化对EMP话题的影响。

What you need to know about EMP weapons
6 June 2025
As we sit, possible poised on the verge of a nuclear conflict in the Northern Hemisphere,
maybe it's time to look at the damaging effects of the electromagnetic pulse that follows
a nuclear detonation.
Apparently, if a nuke is deployed at high altitude, the EMP produced can have some rather
nasty effects on our delicate electronics below.
You can also forget about the inverse-square law to protect you because some components of
the EMP are not "point source" but actually generated by the interaction of gamma radiation
with the earth's magnetic field.  That produces a very large area of EMP which creates
high flux-levels at ground-level, even though the detonation may be tens or hundreds
of Km away.
For this reason therefore, it strikes me that we should all know a little more about
EMPs and ways we could hopefully mitigate the damage they cause.
Apparently there are three phases to the way a nuclear detonation produces an EMP.
However, it's kind of reassuring to know that nukes detonated at or near ground level don't
produce nearly as much EMP as those detonated at 30Km or so above the planet's surface.  To be
truly effective, a nuke designed to disrupt or destroy infrastructure by way of EMP has to
be exploded pretty damned high so direct radiation and thermal damage won't be much of a risk.
During the first phase (known as E1), the detonation creates massive levels of gamma radiation which
interacts with the upper level of earth's atmosphere to strip electrons from the rarefied
gasses there and subsiquently induced massive currents (known as a Compton current)
that creates a magnetic pulse with an extremely fast rise-time, typically 10nS or less.
The result is a burst of EM energy that spans the spectrum from  near-DC to tens of gigahertz
and which induces currents in any conducting material that gets in its way.  The earth's
magnetic field also helps contain this burst of energy, meaning even more of it ends
up directed towards the surface of the planet.
This first phase is what'll fry your computer, your phone and any other sensitive devices
that are not adequately screened from the EMP energy being produced.
After the first phase begins to subside, the second phase (E2) becomes prevailent and that sees
the spectral composition of the EMP change markedly.  Now most of the energy exists in the
Khz to low Mhz range.  This is because the Compton current has now stabilised somewhat
and is changing less rapidly than in phase 1.
While the E1 phase lasts just microseconds, E2 lasts anywhere from hundreds of mS to as long as
several seconds.  Fortunately the reduced intensity and reduced spectral range of E2 means that
it's easier to protect against.
The third phase (E3) can last anywhere from several minutes to tens of minutes and has a much
lower average frequency, typically no more than a few Khz.
This is the phase that is likely to cause issues with longer conductors, such as power lines,
pipelines and other long runs of metal.  This phase could cause damage to transformers,
switching equipment and other vital pieces of energy infrastructure.  It can also cause fires
as a result of arcing and localised heating within conductive structures.
So that's the bad news, what can we do to mitigate all this EMP energy?
The primary tool is the Faraday cage -- or a variant thereof.
In its most effective form, this consists of placing the gear to be protected
inside several layers of conductive material, each separated by an insulating layer.   This works
by converting the magnetic fields generated by the EMP into currents within the conductive layers
and those currents automatically create a magnetic field that opposes the EMP energy which creates
them.  Simple eh?
There are some caveats however.
Firstly, the conductive layers must be free from gaps or holes.  During E1 the frequencies are so
high that even small gaps,cracks or openings could allow enough energy through that the delicate
electronics inside might be fried.   This is another reason to use multiple layers -- so that
any access holes can be staggered layer upon layer such that there's no direct path for energy
to slip through.
Secondly, the devices being protected must be totally enclosed.  No power leads, antennas or other
wiring must be left outside the shielding.

data.title: Semi-Sync Meetings: Stop Wasting Our Time
data.author: marviel
data.article_summary: 大多数会议效率低下，一个人讲话时其他人往往心不在焉，声音最大的人主导讨论，行动项常常被遗忘。这种单线程的会议模式浪费时间、埋没人才并挫伤团队士气。尽管有AI笔记应用，但它们无法解决根本问题。解决方案是改变会议结构：首先进行静默并行工作，然后展开实时讨论，这种方法称为“脑力书写”（brainwriting），能够产生更高质量的想法，并减少认知固化。具体步骤是：先让所有人在共享文档中无声协作10-15分钟，然后用剩余时间集中讨论。这能有效解决传统会议中的序列处理、层级偏见和责任不清问题，缩短会议时间并提高效率。

Authors
Name
Luke Bechtel
Twitter
@linkbechtel
Most meetings are broken. One person talks while everyone else mentally checks out. The loudest voice wins. Action items disappear.
On mute, you wonder:
"what have I done to deserve this fate?"
When speaking, you wonder:
"is anyone even listening?"
You're doing meetings wrong, and it's costing you more than time—it's wasting talent, killing momentum, and frustrating your best contributors.
Despite the hype, AI-powered notetaking apps aren't the answer. They can transcribe what gets said, but they can't fix the fundamental bottleneck: meetings run on a single thread. In computing, single-threaded processes handle one task at a time, while multithreaded systems run multiple processes simultaneously. Most meetings are tragically single-threaded—one brain active while nine others idle.
Solutions
do
exist. Facilitation techniques, structured formats, and asynchronous collaboration methods have been documented and refined for decades. Yet teams keep defaulting to the same dysfunctional patterns, burning hours in circular discussions that could be resolved in minutes.
The fix is to change the fundamental structure: start with silent, parallel work, and
only after
begin a live discussion. This approach—sometimes called "brainwriting" or "silent brainstorming"—has been proven to generate higher-quality ideas and reduce cognitive fixation compared to traditional discussion-first meetings. Research consistently shows that
brainwriting groups generate 20% more ideas and 42% more original ideas
than traditional brainstorming, while eliminating "production blocking"—the bottleneck created when only one person can speak at a time.
Please,
stop wasting our time.
The Problems with Pure Synchronous Meetings
🔄 Serial Processing
: Only one person can speak at a time. By the time it's your turn, you've already started planning dinner.
👑 Hierarchy Bias
: Senior voices carry disproportionate weight. Junior team members with valid concerns stay quiet rather than challenge assumptions.
🎭 Accountability Theater
: "I'll handle that" gets said multiple times with no clear ownership. A week later, nothing's done and everyone points fingers.
The Semi-Synchronous Solution
Solving these problems isn't very hard.
Carve out the first 10-15 minutes for silent collaboration in a shared document, then use the remaining time for focused discussion.
Basic Structure
Semi-Sync Phase (10-15 min)
: Everyone joins a live call and works silently in a shared doc
Sync Phase (15-20 min)
: Audio-on, discuss flagged items and make decisions
Total time
: Usually shorter than traditional meetings
🤐 Phase 1: Semi-Sync (Silent Collaboration)
There are two roles: The
Facilitator
and the
Participants
.
Facilitator Role:
Before the Meeting
Create a shared collaboration space—this should be visible to all participants, and ideally real-time. It may be a document (Notion recommended), a whiteboard (Miro recommended), or a collection of tasks (Jira sprint)
Starting the Meeting
Open with a 30-second orientation:
"We're in silent mode for the next 10 minutes. Add your thoughts to the doc. I'll call time when we're ready to discuss. Please add information, comment on others' ideas, and respond to comments. Tag people directly if they need to see something specific, and flag items for further discussion using emojis."
Monitor the shared document for emerging themes or conflicts
Add structure where the document needs it — i.e. grouping items, tagging items, etc.
Take notes on which items will need verbal discussion
Keep time and provide gentle reminders ("5 minutes left")
Participants:
Add information
: Status updates, concerns, ideas, data
Read information
: Pay attention to what others are adding, ensure they're up to speed
Comment on others' input
: Build on ideas, flag disagreements, ask clarifying questions
Respond to comments
: Answer questions, provide context, acknowledge points
Flag items for discussion
: Mark anything that needs real-time debate (with a simple "DISCUSS" tag)
Rules:
Mics off, cameras optional
Rough notes are fine—perfect prose wastes time
Use @mentions to direct questions to specific people
Don't overthink it—you can clarify verbally in Phase 2
🗣️ Phase 2: Sync (Focused Discussion)
Facilitator Role:
Quickly scan the doc and identify 2-3 items that generated the most activity or conflict
Start with: "I see we need to discuss X, Y, and Z. Let's tackle X first."
Keep discussions focused on resolution, not restating what's already written
Assign clear ownership: "Sarah, you're taking point on this. When can you update us?"
Participants:
Jump straight to problem-solving—no need to re-explain what's in the doc
Build on the written foundation rather than starting from scratch
Commit to specific next steps with timelines

Items with lots of comments usually need discussion

data.title: Curate your shell history
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
Simon Tatham在文章中讨论了为何选择禁用shell历史文件，他通过在`.bashrc`中使用`unset HISTFILE`命令来实现这一点。他指出，这样可以在单个shell实例内保留命令历史，以便修改和重用命令，但不会在不同终端窗口间共享或在注销后保留。他更倾向于将有价值的命令保存在其他地方，如`.bashrc`中的shell函数或独立的脚本文件中，以避免混淆和错误重用。

作者自己则是shell历史最大化主义者，配置zsh保存大量命令历史，但也意识到保存所有错误尝试并无必要。为此，作者创建了一个zsh函数`smite`，用于方便地浏览和删除无用的历史命令，特别是通过fzf工具实现可视化选择和删除。该方法帮助作者保持shell历史的整洁，避免无用命令的干扰。

44200870.article_content:
Simon Tatham wrote an article recently called
“Policy of transience”
, explaining (among other things) why you might want to disable your shell history file. Simon writes:
My unusual habit is:
turn off the history file completely,
by putting the command ‘
unset HISTFILE
’ in my
.bashrc
. I still get history within a single instance of the shell, so I can edit my last command ten times until it works properly; but history isn’t shared between my terminal windows, or preserved when I log out and log in again. All the shell history I allow myself is localised and short-term.
[…]
If I type a shell command that’s
valuable
– one that did something useful enough that I might want it again in future, and long and complicated enough that I’d be annoyed to have to figure it out a second time from scratch – then I can’t rely on it just happening to be in my
.bash_history
. So instead I put it somewhere else: maybe a shell function in my
.bashrc
, or maybe a shell script in my directory of random useful scriptlets. Or maybe just in a file of notes jotted down to myself about useful shell runes to remember.
I find this a more useful way to remember shell commands. Firstly, this procedure separates the
working
version of the command from all the failed attempts just before it. Even within the context of one instance of
bash
I’ll sometimes accidentally recall a
wrong
version of a command when I was aiming for the corrected one two commands later; the idea of having a
year’s worth
of my own false starts available for accidental recall seems horrifying! Instead, I deliberately save
just
the working version, and let all the failed attempts go in the trash when I close the shell.
For me, this idea feels uncomfortable! If anything, I’m a shell history maximalist; I have zsh configured to save my last 9,800 commands.
1
I rely heavily on my shell history to remember how I did things before. I suspect my most-used form of zsh completion is to complete the current command line from a history entry.
But I also think Simon makes a good point about how useless it is to record all of your false starts. Why save
cd ~/Dekstop
, which I’m never going to want to run again?
2
Why save
vim /etc/rc.conf
when
sudo vim /etc/rc.conf
is what I meant 100% of the time? At best, these dead-end commands are taking up unnecessary space in my history file. At worst, they’ll trip me up
again
the next time I need to do the same thing and naively run the first command from my history that looks right.
For myself, I don’t want my shell history to be opt-in. But I
can
make it easier to remove the typos and dead ends. I came up with this zsh function to facilitate that:
function
smite
()
{
setopt
LOCAL_OPTIONS ERR_RETURN PIPE_FAIL
local
opts
=
(
-I
)
if
[[
$1
==
'-a'
]];
then
opts
=
()
elif
[[
-n
$1
]];
then
print
>&
2
'usage: smite [-a]'
return
1
fi
fc
-l
-n
$opts
1
|
\
fzf
--no-sort
--tac
--multi
|
\
while
IFS
=
''
read
-r
command_to_delete
;
do
printf
'Removing history entry "%s"\n'
$command_to_delete
local
HISTORY_IGNORE
=
"
${(
b
)command_to_delete}
"
fc
-W
fc
-p
$HISTFILE
$HISTSIZE
$SAVEHIST
done
}
Running
smite
opens an
fzf
-powered browser with your shell history in it. (So you’ll need fzf installed, but that’s the only dependency.) By default, you’ll only see your history from the current session, but running
smite -a
shows all of your history.
When you navigate to an entry and press
Return
or
Enter
, zsh will delete all instances of that command from your history. If you want to delete multiple commands at once, you can select them by pressing
Tab
on each one and then typing
Return
to commit your changes.
Multiline commands are not handled correctly, for now.
The function prints back all of the commands it’s deleting, just in case you select the wrong one.
Here’s a video:
The approach is taken from
this Stack Overflow answer
by Marlon Richert, who later wrote a zsh plugin called
zsh-hist
to make the history system easier to deal with. (I haven’t tried the plugin, but it seems to make it possible to delete the history entry with a given number, which is the omission in zsh that prevents multi-line commands from being easy to delete.)
Even if my zsh code isn’t relevant to you, I hope you’ve taken a moment to consider what you want out of your shell history and if there’s anything you could tweak to get closer to that.
Since adding this function to my zshrc, I’ve been paying more attention to which commands are misfires, and pruning the ones that are. If my history file is never quite going to be a beautiful garden, I can at least put more effort into removing the weeds.
I rarely use more than 200 commands in a single shell session, so by starting each session at history number 9801, I can mostly use the bang history feature (e.g.
!9857
) without needing to type more than four digits.
↩︎
I mean, realistically I wouldn’t lean on my shell history for
cd ~/Desktop
anyway, but imagine a much longer command with a typo in it.
↩︎

data.title: A proposal to restrict sites from accessing a users’ local network
data.author: doener
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了一项由Chrome安全网络团队提出的提案，旨在限制公共网站未经用户许可访问其本地网络。当前，公共网站可以探测用户的本地网络并发动针对本地设备的CSRF攻击，利用浏览器作为“被迷惑的代理”来攻击用户的本地设备。为解决此问题，提案建议取消公共网站直接访问私有IP地址的能力，要求用户明确授予网站访问本地网络的权限。

该提案基于Chrome此前暂停的“私有网络访问（PNA）”工作，但通过权限控制替代预检请求，以增加用户控制并简化实施。目标包括阻止通过网页利用本地 vulnerable 设备，并允许在用户明确期望和允许的情况下，公共网站与本地设备通信。提案不打算破坏依赖本地设备控制的现有工作流程，也不解决本地网络HTTPS问题。

主要用例包括：普通用户防止未经授权的访问，以及通过公共网站前端设置和控制本地设备（如物联网设备、家庭路由器等）。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：浏览器或操作系统对本地资源（如本地网络、USB、蓝牙）的访问控制

不同观点：
• **支持加强本地资源访问控制**：
   - [mystifyingpoi] 认为网站不应默认能够访问任意本地IP，建议通过弹窗让用户选择允许或拒绝。
   - [socalgal2] 希望对USB和蓝牙的访问也采取类似控制，建议应用程序只能访问预定义的设备ID。
   - [skybrian] 认为目前的方案过于粗略，应该限制网站只能访问特定的本地服务器，而不是所有本地资源。
   - [bmacho] 完全同意此提议，认为应阻止网站随意访问localhost，但也希望在用户许可下实现设备间的资源共享。

• **对当前情况的批评和担忧**：
   - [paxys] 指出浏览器默认行为存在安全隐患，任何本地网络服务都可能被网站访问，安全依赖于服务器配置。
   - [sroussey] 提到此举可能阻止Meta等公司通过本地通信绕过限制，保护用户隐私。
   - [rerdavies] 担心IPv6地址的识别问题，尤其是在IoT应用中，并指出目前本地网络使用自签名证书的困难。

• **技术实现和替代方案**：
   - [pacifika] 提到Internet Explorer曾通过分区系统解决此问题。
   - [G_o_D] 解释CORS并不能完全阻止请求发送，但可以通过代理服务器绕过，建议慎重考虑完全禁止localhost访问。
   - [ronsor] 指出由于NPAPI插件的移除，许多本地软件依赖localhost进行公共网站的交互，完全限制可能造成困扰。

• **对现有安全机制的质疑**：
   - [AshamedCaptain] 质疑为何不依赖同源策略解决此问题，认为基于IP地址范围的保护标准不妥。

补充讨论：
• **简化浏览器的呼声**：
   - [1vuio0pswjnm7] 认为现代浏览器过于复杂，支持使用简单、无JavaScript功能的浏览器以避免安全问题。

争议焦点：
• 是否应默认允许网站访问本地资源，以及如何在安全和用户便利之间取得平衡。
• IPv6地址的识别问题及其对提案可行性的影响。
• 完全禁止localhost访问可能导致的兼容性问题，如rclone的OAuth机制可能失效。

总体来看，讨论围绕如何在保障安全的前提下，不影响用户对本地资源和服务的正常使用。

Explainer for Local Network Access
This proposal is an early design sketch by the Chrome Secure Web and Network team to describe the problem below and solicit feedback on the proposed solution. It has not been approved to ship in Chrome.
Proponents
Chrome Secure Web and Network team
Participate
https://github.com/explainers-by-googlers/local-network-access/issues
Introduction
Currently public websites can probe a user's local network, perform CSRF attacks against vulnerable local devices, and generally abuse the user's browser as a "confused deputy" that has access inside the user's local network or software on their local machine. For example, if you visit
evil.com
it can use your browser as a springboard to attack your printer (given an HTTP accessible printer exploit).
Local Network Access aims to prevent these undesired requests to insecure devices on the local network. This is achieved by deprecating direct access to private IP addresses from public websites, and instead requiring that the user grants permission to the initiating website to make connections to their local network.
Note:
This proposal builds on top of Chrome's previously paused
Private Network Access (PNA) work
, but differs by gating access on a permission rather than via preflight requests. This increases the level of user control (at the expense of new permissions that have to be explained to the user) but removes the explicit "device opt-in" that the preflight design achieved. We believe this simpler design will be easier to ship, in order to mitigate the real risks of local network access today. Unlike the previous Private Network Access proposal, which required changes to devices on local networks, this approach should only require changes to sites that need to access the local network. Sites are much easier to update than devices, and so this approach should be much more straightforward to roll out.
Goals
Stop exploitation of vulnerable devices and servers from the drive-by web.
Allow public websites to communicate to private network devices when the user expects it and explicitly allows it.
An adjacent goal is that we want a path for browsers to be good stewards of OS-level local network access permissions. These OS-level permissions are increasingly common (
on iOS, and more recently on macOS
) -- simply because the
browser
has been granted the permission (for legitimate browser functionality the user may want to use, like mirroring the contents of a tab on a local device) should not expose users' local devices to the risks of the open web.
Non-goals
Break existing workflows and services that rely on a public web frontend that can control local network devices.
As long as there is
some
path forward we should be okay with breaking some use cases (e.g., iframe and HTML subresources that aren't explicitly sourced from local hostnames), but overall we want to minimize breakage.
Solve the local network HTTPS problem.
As stated in the
original Private Network Access explainer
:
Provide a secure mechanism for initiating HTTPS connections to services running on the local network or the user's machine. This piece is missing to allow secure public websites to embed non-public resources without running into mixed content violations, with the exception of
http://localhost
which is embeddable. While a useful goal, and maybe even a necessary one in order to deploy Private Network Access more widely, it is out of scope of this specification.
Use cases
Use case 1
The most common case is for users who don't have any services or devices on their local network that expect connections from websites. Today, browsers freely allow JavaScript and subresource requests to these devices without any indication to the end user. Unless this behavior is expected by the user, users should not be exposed to this risk by default.
Use case 2
Public web frontend for controlling or setting up local devices (such as an IoT device, home router, etc.).
Device manufacturers want to be able to give users an easy process for setting up a new device, and one method that is used is to have a page hosted on the manufacturer's public website which then communicates with the device via the user's browser,

data.author: walterbell
data.article_summary: 本文简要列出了与YouTube和相关服务相关的各类信息和功能。内容包括关于YouTube的介绍、新闻、版权声明、联系方式、创作者信息、广告、开发者条款、隐私政策、安全政策以及YouTube的使用方式和新增功能测试，还提及了NFL Sunday Ticket服务，并注明版权为2025年Google LLC所有。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：数字产品的长久可用性与存储介质的可靠性，以及消费者权益的保护。

不同观点：
• [ksec] 认为可靠的存储介质（如专业CD、游戏卡带）在过去能够长时间保存，但现在网络已经完全取代了这种存储方式，导致数字产品的长久可用性下降。他提出，如果无法通过技术手段解决存储介质的问题，可能需要通过法律来保护消费者的权益，确保数字产品在购买后能够在一定年限内继续下载。他还批评了Google、Apple等公司对消费者购买的数字产品控制过度。

• [Sniffnoy] 提到了Ross Scott的Stop Killing Games运动，指出该运动与讨论相关，但没有进一步展开对解决方案的讨论。

• [evbogue] 分享了个人经历，表示曾多次申请相关公司的工作但未收到回复，暗示了与这些公司沟通不畅的问题，但未直接讨论存储或消费者权益问题。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是数字产品的长久可用性和存储介质的可靠性。随着网络的普及和存储技术的发展，传统存储介质的优势正在消失，但网络存储并不能完全解决长久保存的问题。

• [ksec] 提出的法律保护消费者权益的建议值得注意，尤其是在数字产品越来越普遍的今天，如何确保消费者能够长期访问和使用自己购买的数字内容是一个重要的议题。

• [Sniffnoy] 提到的Stop Killing Games运动可能提供了另一个视角，即通过公众运动和倡议来推动数字产品长久可用性的改善。

• [evbogue] 的经历显示了与相关公司沟通不畅的问题，可能暗示了在解决数字产品长久可用性问题上存在一定的组织和管理障碍。
